dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, I'm lost. This market is very big!
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, aɪm ˈlɔːst. ðɪs ˈmɑːrkɪt ɪz ˈvɛri ˈbɪɡ!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Me too! Excuse me, where's the train station?
dialogue.reading: ˈmiː ˈtuː! ɪkˈskjuːz miː, ˈwɛrz ðə ˈtreɪn ˌsteɪʃən?

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: The station? It's that way. Follow me.
dialogue.reading: ðə ˈsteɪʃən? ɪts ˈðæt ˈweɪ. ˈfɑːloʊ miː.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: No, it's near. This way, please.
dialogue.reading: ˈnoʊ, ɪts ˈnɪr. ˈðɪs ˈweɪ, ˈpliːz.
